class.name: WorldPartition3D
class.brief_description: Streams 3D scene cells around a moving observer.
class.description: [WorldPartition3D] divides its local X/Z plane into square cells and loads registered [PackedScene] resources around an observer node. The Y coordinate does not influence cell selection. Each registered scene must have a [Node3D] root; the root's local position is offset by the cell origin. Each cell is described by a [Vector2i] coordinate and a scene resource path in [member cell_scenes]. Assets are requested on background threads; instantiation and deletion happen on the main thread. Request and instantiation budgets limit per-frame work. Optional predictive streaming can preload one cell ahead of the observer using [member predictive_velocity], [member predictive_lookahead_seconds], and [member predictive_max_distance]. Current cells and pinned hubs always take priority over speculative work. [method set_streaming_source] registers up to 8 named world-space sources (radius 0 or 1 cell) for mission targets, cameras and portals. They run after observer cells and pinned hubs, before the speculative velocity forecast, using the same asynchronous work budgets. Each source has a priority 0 through 3; urgent sources are scheduled before background sources without starving immediate observer work. Equal priorities use stable alphabetical ordering by name. For fast travel, use [method get_streaming_source_progress] and [method is_streaming_source_ready] to wait non-blockingly for registered destination scenes to instantiate; do not assume the source is ready immediately after registration. They are runtime-only, not persistent pins. The [member load_radius] and [member unload_radius] define square neighborhoods in grid-cell units. The unload radius must not be smaller than the load radius; a larger unload radius prevents repeated loading at cell boundaries. For persistent camps or quest hubs, use [method pin_cell] and [method unpin_cell] to override distance-based unloading. At most 128 registered cells may be pinned; a disabled streamer still unloads all cells. To activate collision separately from simulation and visuals, set [member physics_radius], [member physics_hysteresis_cells] and [member max_physics_transitions_per_frame]. Pinned cells and important/urgent sources automatically request full-detail physics while ordinary preloads remain dormant. Scene roots opt into [code]set_streaming_physics_active(active)[/code]. Use [method is_streaming_source_physics_ready] to wait for collision activation after a physics tick; a scene can additionally implement [code]is_streaming_physics_ready()[/code] to validate its own colliders. This policy never automatically disables collision in other nodes. To stage gameplay transitions, [method is_streaming_source_activation_ready] requires live source roots, [member min_physics_frames_after_load] elapsed engine physics ticks and any scene-defined [code]is_streaming_activation_ready()[/code] check. This is intentionally stricter than [method is_streaming_source_ready], which requires only live scene roots. It cannot guarantee arbitrary physics/navmesh/GPU readiness unless your scene implements the relevant check. To avoid completely regenerating the grid tile for every dynamic obstacle, [method patch_navigation_tile] uses the unchanged NavMesh vertices, an old and new blocker snapshot, and shared obstacle/slope filtering to recheck only affected polygons. [method get_last_navigation_tile_retested_triangle_count] exposes how much geometry work occurred. This is a bounded synchronous optimization, not background baking. To support live obstacle editing without reloading cell scenes, [method mark_cell_navigation_dirty] invalidates an opted-in loaded cell and schedules its scene-owned [code]rebuild_streaming_navigation_mesh()[/code] callback under [member max_navigation_rebuilds_per_physics_frame]. Repeated marks coalesce, pending tiles are not reported navigation-ready, and a successful rebuild increments the cell revision and world generation for path-cache invalidation. To construct native grid-based terrain navigation meshes while excluding circular static obstacles and steep slopes, use [method build_navigation_tile] with sampled terrain heights and local obstacle footprints. It expands blockers by agent radius, bounds the work and returns a [NavigationMesh] resource; this is not Recast baking and does not manage the returned resource's lifecycle. To stream real authored NavigationRegion3D meshes independently of render, collision and NPC simulation, configure [member navigation_radius], [member navigation_hysteresis_cells] and [member max_navigation_transitions_per_frame]. An opt-in scene root implements [code]set_streaming_navigation_active(active)[/code], and can use [code]is_streaming_navigation_ready()[/code] to report actual region readiness. The engine allows two physics ticks before [method is_cell_navigation_ready] returns true, enabling safe NavigationServer synchronization without forced server flush. This does not automatically generate navigation polygons or establish connectivity for arbitrary scenes. To provide cheap cross-cell quest corridors without baking a navmesh, use [method find_cell_path] on registered grid cells. It uses bounded deterministic breadth-first search and optionally requires live loaded cells; collision avoidance remains the caller's responsibility. To budget costly NPC pathfinding and local obstacle avoidance, register live Node3D agents using [method register_navigation_agent], call [method try_acquire_navigation_update] from their physics processing to decide when to recalculate steering, and call [method unregister_navigation_agent_if_owner] on removal. [member max_navigation_updates_per_physics_frame] bounds native permits per fixed physics frame. This is a task scheduler, not an authored navigation mesh or a replacement for NavigationAgent3D updates. Optionally set [member simulation_radius] to gate AI/script activity independently from graphics. An opt-in scene root implements [code]set_streaming_simulation_active(active)[/code] and can pause its own processing; game systems may query [method is_cell_simulation_active] or subscribe to [signal cell_simulation_changed]. Activation is not automatic tree-wide pausing. Changes to existing loaded cells are limited by [member max_simulation_transitions_per_frame], and [member simulation_hysteresis_cells] reduces oscillations. Optionally set [member detail_radius] to enable near/distant scene-detail callbacks. A cell root script must implement [code]set_streaming_lod(level)[/code], where 0 means near detail and 1 means distant. The engine invokes this method before the new root enters the tree (so its [code]_ready()[/code] can generate only the required content), and again when an existing cell changes tier. Changes are bounded by [member max_detail_transitions_per_frame]. Optionally increase [member detail_hysteresis_cells] to suppress LOD oscillation while the observer moves around grid boundaries. Pinned cells always receive level 0. This does not generate simplified meshes automatically; the scene script must provide both representations. Gameplay systems can claim and persist cells independently of the observer. [method pin_cell] and [method acquire_cell_lease] keep cells resident (pins in insertion order are streamed first, leases are reference counted per owner and [method acquire_cell_route] reserves a whole corridor atomically); both work without any valid observer. [method set_layer_enabled] activates or deactivates named runtime data layers assigned with [method set_cell_layer]; a disabled layer always wins over pins and leases. [method set_cell_state], [method snapshot_cell_states] and [method load_cell_states] persist per-cell gameplay dictionaries captured from scene roots through [code]capture_streaming_state()[/code] and restored through [code]restore_streaming_state(state)[/code]; [member persist_rigid_bodies] and [member persist_streaming_objects] opt into rigid-body and stateful-child capture. [method set_cell_navigation_enabled] and [method set_cell_navigation_link_enabled] are explicit, persisted gameplay gates for [NavigationRegion3D] and [NavigationLink3D] nodes and block route reservations; they are independent of the distance-based navigation tier. Scene roots may implement [code]streaming_activated(cell)[/code] and [code]streaming_deactivating(cell)[/code], mirrored by [signal cell_activated] and [signal cell_deactivating]. Distance-based unloads are limited per frame by [member max_unloads_per_frame]. [WorldPartition3D] does not generate terrain, divide an authored scene into cells, or build HLOD meshes. Those authoring stages can produce the [PackedScene] files consumed by this runtime node. [codeblock] var partition := WorldPartition3D.new() partition.cell_size = 128.0 partition.load_radius = 1 partition.unload_radius = 2 add_child(partition) partition.observer_path = partition.get_path_to($Player) partition.set_cell_scene(Vector2i(0, 0), "res://world/cell_0_0.tscn") partition.set_cell_scene(Vector2i(-1, 0), "res://world/cell_-1_0.tscn") [/codeblock] For example, [code]partition.set_streaming_source("quest", $Objective.global_position, 0, 0)[/code] keeps the objective's scene cell loaded while the player explores; call [code]partition.remove_streaming_source("quest")[/code] after completion. This requires a valid configured observer. It never automatically registers a [PackedScene] for a source cell. Streaming is disabled while editing a scene; the node processes automatically while the game runs. Call [method update_streaming] if an immediate update is required after moving the observer.

method.name: set_max_cell_path_cache_entries
method.description: Sets the maximum number of cached named grid-route query results to retain, 0 to 128 (default 64). Zero disables caching. Changing the capacity discards stored paths but preserves cumulative hit/miss counters. This is an exact-key, per-WorldPartition3D LRU cache, not NavigationServer3D path caching.

method.name: get_max_cell_path_cache_entries
method.description: Returns the number of entries allowed in the bounded shortest-cell-route cache.

method.name: get_cell_path_cache_entry_count
method.description: Returns the number of currently stored route results, including empty/disconnected paths. Registered-topology changes evict all cached routes, while ordinary loaded-scene changes evict only loaded_only results.

method.name: get_cell_path_cache_hit_count
method.description: Returns the cumulative number of successful cached calls to find_cell_path. Returned arrays are always duplicated, so gameplay scripts cannot mutate cached routes. This counter saturates at the signed 32-bit maximum until reset.

method.name: get_cell_path_cache_miss_count
method.description: Returns the cumulative count of route searches not satisfied by the cache, including when the cache is disabled and invalid or disconnected routes. This counter saturates until reset.

method.name: clear_cell_path_cache
method.description: Clears all cached cell routes, hit and miss counters, and the LRU clock. Does not change cell registrations, live scene roots or the NavigationServer3D mesh.

method.name: patch_navigation_tile
method.description: Incrementally updates a previously built regular-grid [NavigationMesh] when circular obstacle footprints have changed, without resampling terrain or reevaluating every triangle's slope and clearance. [param previous] must originate from [method build_navigation_tile] or an earlier patch with the same [param resolution], terrain vertices, agent radius and maximum slope. [param previous_blockers] and [param blockers] must describe the entire old and new footprint sets (each at most 256 finite [code]Vector3(local_x, local_z, radius)[/code]). The engine compares the sets as multisets, including duplicates, automatically combines expanded influence bounds for added, removed and moved footprints, re-tests only overlapping triangles with the same native collision and slope filter as the full builder, and retains all unaffected triangle occupancy. Polygon ordering matches a full tile build. A change in blocker order alone returns [param previous] unchanged, with zero geometric re-tests. If the cached polygon topology is malformed, the method falls back to a full build for correctness. Invalid input returns [code]null[/code]. It returns a new mesh resource for actual changes, so callers can safely replace [NavigationRegion3D.navigation_mesh] after publication and rely on navigation server physics-frame synchronization. No moving-geometry detection, terrain-height edits or asynchronous worker is implied.

method.name: get_last_navigation_tile_retested_triangle_count
method.description: Returns how many triangle slope/obstacle tests the last call to [method build_navigation_tile] or [method patch_navigation_tile] performed on this instance (including zero for a no-change patch). This is a CPU-work diagnostic, not frame time or polygon count; even incremental patching scans bounded old polygon masks and candidate triangle bounds. In Aurora Forest, a complete 16 by 16 tile tests 512 triangles, while a local barricade normally retests only a small subset.

method.name: set_max_navigation_rebuilds_per_physics_frame
method.description: Sets the maximum number of dynamic streamed navigation mesh rebuild callbacks attempted per engine physics frame, from 1 to 16 (default 1). Repeated calls to update_streaming within the same physics frame cannot exceed this budget. This is distinct from NavMesh region activation transitions and agent path request grants.

method.name: get_max_navigation_rebuilds_per_physics_frame
method.description: Returns the per-physics-frame budget for dynamically rebuilding scene-owned NavMesh tiles.

method.name: mark_cell_navigation_dirty
method.description: Coalesces a navigation mesh invalidation request for a loaded, opted-in scene root exposing [code]rebuild_streaming_navigation_mesh() - bool[/code]. Returns false for unloaded/unsupported scenes or when the bounded pending set is full (128 cell IDs). A dirty tile fails [method is_cell_navigation_ready] until the scheduler receives Boolean true from the scene callback, then waits two physics frames for NavigationServer3D synchronization. Inactive cells keep their request pending until activated; repeated requests for the same cell do not add extra work. The callback must construct and publish its own new NavigationMesh resource. Failed callbacks stay pending and can be retried under the next frame budget.

method.name: get_navigation_dirty_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of distinct loaded cells with a pending NavMesh rebuild, including temporarily navigation-inactive cells. Queued marks are discarded on cell unload.

method.name: get_cell_navigation_revision
method.description: Returns the successful dynamic NavMesh rebuild count for a live cell (initially 0), or -1 when the cell is not loaded. The counter resets on scene unload/reload and saturates at the signed 32-bit limit.

method.name: get_navigation_mesh_generation
method.description: Returns a monotonic whole-world navigation topology generation. Incremented when a cell scene loads or unloads, a navigation region activates/deactivates, a new dirty tile is marked, or a dynamic tile rebuild succeeds. A cached path must be reconsidered after the generation changes, including when an intermediate NavMesh region changes; this count does not prove path availability.

method.name: build_navigation_tile
method.description: Builds a bounded, non-Recast 3D terrain navigation mesh from a regular row-major (Z then X) grid of sampled local [Vector3] vertices. For [param resolution] (2 to 32), [param vertices] must have exactly [code](resolution + 1)²[/code] finite samples; this can generate at most 2048 triangles. The input [param blockers] stores up to 256 circular obstacle footprints, each as [code]Vector3(local_x, local_z, obstacle_radius)[/code] (the third component is a radius, not elevation). For each candidate triangle, the engine checks its up-facing normal against [param max_slope_degrees] (0 to 89), then conservatively rejects the triangle if its XZ footprint intersects any obstacle disc expanded by [param agent_radius] (0 to 8). Disc tests include triangle edges and corners, not just centroid samples. Invalid inputs return [code]null[/code]. The result is a grid-based, deterministic walkable-surface approximation for static circular obstacles; it does not invoke Recast, update any live [NavigationRegion3D], or automatically bake scene geometry. The caller owns the returned resource and must attach it to an enabled region. Neighbor tiles should share border vertices and blocker rules to preserve connectivity. Filtering can remove entire small polygons and create disconnected islands; it is not full 3D collision or height-clearance proof.

method.name: set_navigation_radius
method.description: Controls independent navigation-region activation radius around the observer: -1 disables the policy (all loaded cells active, default), 0 to 32 selects an inner radius. Pinned hubs and priority 2/3 streaming sources force navigation-active regardless of distance. Games opt in by implementing [code]set_streaming_navigation_active(active)[/code] on each scene root.

method.name: get_navigation_radius
method.description: Returns the current independent navigation-region activation radius.

method.name: set_navigation_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Sets 0 to 8 extra cell rings in which previously active navigation regions may remain active. Inactive cells activate only within the inner radius, important source radius or pinned hubs.

method.name: get_navigation_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Returns navigation tier demotion hysteresis in grid cells.

method.name: set_max_navigation_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Caps live-cell navigation region activation/deactivation transitions at 1 to 64 per streaming update. Initial scene state is applied before [code]_ready()[/code]. Independent of the maximum expensive per-agent navigation update budget.

method.name: get_max_navigation_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Returns navigation-region transition budget per update, distinct from path-recalculation grants.

method.name: is_cell_navigation_active
method.description: Returns the native navigation-region activation policy's current state for a live cell, false for missing or unloaded cells. The scene callback must create/enable or disable its own NavigationRegion3D nodes; arbitrary scenes are never modified automatically.

method.name: get_navigation_active_cell_count
method.description: Counts live loaded cells currently marked as navigation-active by the native region activation policy. Not the number of NavigationServer polygons or synchronized regions.

method.name: is_cell_navigation_ready
method.description: Returns true only for a live, navigation-active cell after at least two engine physics frames since activation and when an optional [code]is_streaming_navigation_ready()[/code] callback returns Boolean true. Callbacks without a valid Boolean fail closed. If a scene has no callback, this only proves the activation age, not the existence of a NavMesh or server connectivity.

method.name: is_streaming_source_navigation_ready
method.description: Requires an existing loaded named streaming source and all registered source cells to pass [method is_cell_navigation_ready]. Pinned hubs and priority 2/3 source cells can force navigation to become active. A positive result is not a guarantee of complete navmesh connectivity, global pathfinding or object-radius clearance.

method.name: find_cell_path
method.description: Returns a deterministic shortest 4-connected route of [Vector2i] cell coordinates, including both endpoints, across registered scene cells. Results (including empty routes) are stored in a bounded LRU cache when [member max_cell_path_cache_entries] is nonzero, keyed by exact signed coordinates and [code]loaded_only[/code]. Returned arrays are always duplicated so gameplay cannot mutate the cached result. Native scene registration changes invalidate all entries, while scene load/unload events invalidate only loaded-only routes; active NavMesh obstacle patches do not affect the registered-cell graph. Invalid, empty or disconnected coordinates return an empty [Array]. With [code]loaded_only=true[/code], every route cell must be a currently live instantiated scene root; otherwise this plans through registered cells even when unloaded. At most 512 cells are visited per query; exceeding the cap fails closed with an empty route, preventing unbounded synchronous work. This is a topological streaming corridor, not a collision-free [NavigationMesh] path or route around trees. Equal-length alternatives use +X, +Z, -X, -Z neighbor order for reproducibility. Grid coordinates are checked against 32-bit overflow.

method.name: set_max_navigation_updates_per_physics_frame
method.description: Sets the global per-physics-frame budget for expensive navigation/steering recomputations, from 1 to 64 (default 2). This scheduler grants update slots; it does not run pathfinding, bake a navigation mesh, or automatically slow down Node physics processing.

method.name: get_max_navigation_updates_per_physics_frame
method.description: Returns the configured maximum updates allowed across all active registered navigation agents in a single engine physics frame.

method.name: register_navigation_agent
method.description: Registers or replaces one named agent as a weak ObjectID reference. Name length 1 to 64; priorities 0 (background) to 3 (urgent). At most 128 entries; duplicate names are upserted but registering the same Node3D under two distinct names is rejected. Returns false for invalid data or exceeded capacity. Register after adding the agent to a SceneTree, and call unregister when it is removed.

method.name: unregister_navigation_agent
method.description: Removes an agent by name. If this ID may be reused by a new NPC before the old one exits, prefer [method unregister_navigation_agent_if_owner] to prevent a stale object's cleanup from removing the replacement.

method.name: unregister_navigation_agent_if_owner
method.description: Unregisters only if the supplied Node3D currently owns this name. Returns false for missing, null or replaced nodes; avoids stale NPC cleanup unregistering a newly spawned actor.

method.name: has_navigation_agent
method.description: Returns whether the name is present in the runtime agent registry; stale weak references are pruned during the next scheduling pass.

method.name: get_navigation_agent_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered agent entries, including dormant agents. Automatic stale-reference cleanup runs during scheduling; callers should unregister on scene exit.

method.name: set_navigation_agent_priority
method.description: Sets registered agent priority 0 to 3; higher priorities receive scarce update slots first. A change takes effect from the next physics-frame selection, not retroactively in an already frozen frame.

method.name: get_navigation_agent_priority
method.description: Returns priority 0 to 3 or -1 for an unknown agent name.

method.name: try_acquire_navigation_update
method.description: Grants one steering/path recalculation slot to a registered agent selected for the current physics frame, at most once per agent and without exceeding [member max_navigation_updates_per_physics_frame]. Only live, tree-bound physics-processing agents in loaded, simulation-active, physics-active cells are eligible. Selection is priority-first then least-recently-selected, then alphabetical for deterministic ties; decisions are frozen per physics frame, regardless of agent callback order. Call from physics processing only; reuse cached steering when false. No automatic navmesh computation is performed. Equal-priority agents share slots fairly; a permanently higher priority can monopolize a saturated budget.

method.name: get_navigation_updates_used_this_frame
method.description: Returns how many selected navigation updates have actually been consumed in the current engine physics frame; returns zero when the cached schedule belongs to an older frame. Useful for profiling HUDs, but not an absolute CPU or pathfinding cost metric.

method.name: set_physics_radius
method.description: Sets the independent cell collision radius (-1: disabled/all loaded physics active; 0 to 32: distance-based activation). Priority 2/3 sources and pinned hubs override distance. The engine calls an optional [code]set_streaming_physics_active(active)[/code] on scene roots; it does not automatically alter arbitrary collision objects.

method.name: get_physics_radius
method.description: Returns the independent physics active radius. -1 keeps all loaded cells active, preserving previous behavior.

method.name: set_physics_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Sets 0 to 8 additional cell rings where previously active physics can remain active before deactivating. Pinned and important source cells always stay active.

method.name: get_physics_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Returns the additional hysteresis rings for active collision cells.

method.name: set_max_physics_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Limits physics activation changes for already-loaded cells to 1 to 64 per frame. Initial state is set before scene [code]_ready()[/code] and does not count against this limit.

method.name: get_max_physics_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Returns the per-frame physics tier transition budget.

method.name: is_cell_physics_active
method.description: Returns the native physics activation policy for an existing live cell, false for unloaded cells. A true value alone does not prove collider properties have changed; scene root scripts must implement [code]set_streaming_physics_active(active)[/code] to filter their own collision.

method.name: get_physics_active_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of live loaded cells the engine currently marks physics-active; used for monitoring spatial collision budgets.

method.name: is_cell_physics_ready
method.description: Returns true only after a live cell is marked physics-active, at least one physics tick has elapsed since it was enabled, and an optional scene root [code]is_streaming_physics_ready()[/code] returns Boolean [code]true[/code]. This is an opt-in gameplay readiness check, not a universal physics-server synchronization guarantee.

method.name: is_streaming_source_physics_ready
method.description: Requires a named source with registered center, all its registered scene roots loaded, every root's native physics tier active and each cell passing [method is_cell_physics_ready]. Use together with [method is_streaming_source_activation_ready] for urgent fast travel. Background priority 0 and normal priority 1 sources do not automatically activate remote physics.

method.name: set_min_physics_frames_after_load
method.description: Sets the minimum completed engine physics frames (0 to 8, default 2) between scene root instantiation and activation readiness. It does not block loading or guarantee that arbitrary physics, navigation or GPU resources have finished initializing.

method.name: get_min_physics_frames_after_load
method.description: Returns the minimum physics-frame delay required by [method is_cell_activation_ready].

method.name: is_cell_activation_ready
method.description: Returns true only when the cell has a live instantiated scene root, the minimum number of engine physics frames has elapsed since that instance was added, and an optional scene root [code]is_streaming_activation_ready()[/code] callback returns [code]true[/code]. A callback returning a non-boolean value fails closed. Missing or unloaded cells return false. This is a gameplay activation fence, not a universal collision, navigation or GPU readiness check.

method.name: get_streaming_source_activated_cell_count
method.description: Counts registered source cells whose live scene roots pass the physics-frame delay and the optional readiness callback. Sparse unregistered neighboring cells are ignored; an unregistered center produces zero.

method.name: get_streaming_source_activation_progress
method.description: Returns 0.0 to 1.0 as activation-ready cells divided by registered destination cells. Zero means the source is missing, has no registered center, or has no activated cells. This is not byte-level resource download or GPU pipeline progress.

method.name: is_streaming_source_activation_ready
method.description: Returns true only if [method is_streaming_source_ready] is true, and every registered cell in the source radius passes [method is_cell_activation_ready]. Use this before staged fast travel or spawning AI. Game code must still verify safe spawn positions and any additional custom collision or navigation prerequisites.

method.name: get_simulation_radius
method.description: Returns the independent AI/script activation radius, -1 when the simulation tier is disabled.

method.name: set_simulation_radius
method.description: Sets the inner active simulation radius in grid cells. -1 leaves simulation active in all loaded cells (default); 0 to 32 uses distance from the observer. Pinned cells always remain active. This does not unload geometry or automatically disable scene processes.

method.name: get_simulation_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Returns extra cell rings tolerated before an already-active scene is deactivated. Newly inactive cells reactivate only inside [member simulation_radius].

method.name: set_simulation_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Sets 0 to 8 extra demotion rings for active simulation, suppressing rapid AI start/stop around cell boundaries.

method.name: get_max_simulation_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Returns the maximum number of already-loaded cell activation changes processed per streaming update.

method.name: set_max_simulation_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Limits existing-cell activation transitions to 1 to 64 per frame. Initial activation is applied on instantiation and not charged against this budget.

method.name: is_cell_simulation_active
method.description: Returns the native simulation policy's current state for a live cell. False for absent/unloaded cells. Distinct from visual detail level. Game-owned AI/controllers must use this state or implement the callback; the engine does not automatically pause physics or navigation.

method.name: get_simulation_active_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of live loaded cells currently marked as simulation-active, including pinned hubs. This is a state count, not a CPU-time metric.

method.name: set_streaming_source_priority
method.description: Changes an existing named source's priority without moving it or changing its radius. Valid values are 0 (background), 1 (normal), 2 (important), 3 (urgent). Returns [code]false[/code] if the name is unknown or the priority is invalid. Only work waiting for a frame budget is reordered; already-running threaded resource requests are not preempted.

method.name: get_streaming_source_priority
method.description: Returns the registered source priority between 0 and 3. Returns -1 for unknown source names. Higher values are processed first after the primary observer and pinned hub cells.

method.name: get_streaming_source_cell_count
method.description: Returns how many [PackedScene] cells are registered in the named source's square radius (0 or 1). Unregistered sparse neighbors are ignored, but an unregistered source center returns zero so it can never be considered ready.

method.name: get_streaming_source_loaded_cell_count
method.description: Returns how many registered cells in this source currently have live, instantiated [Node3D] roots. A root queued for deletion does not count. Does not issue load requests.

method.name: get_streaming_source_failed_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered cells inside this source whose asynchronous load has failed. Games can abort their staging operation rather than waiting indefinitely.

method.name: get_streaming_source_progress
method.description: Returns 0 to 1 as live instantiated cells divided by registered cells. Zero means no valid destination or no cells loaded; 1 means all relevant scene roots are present. This is scene activation progress, not byte-level loading or GPU upload progress.

method.name: is_streaming_source_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] only when streaming is enabled, the node is in the scene tree with a valid [Node3D] observer, the named source's center has a registered scene, all registered scenes in its radius have live root instances and none have failed. Missing sources and missing center scenes return [code]false[/code]. This does not guarantee collisions, navigation meshes, physics synchronization or GPU resource readiness.

method.name: get_cell_instance
method.description: Returns the currently instantiated [Node3D] root for [param cell], or [code]null[/code] if no live instance exists (including after it is queued for deletion). Use this to attach cell-specific gameplay, read biome metadata, or inspect the scene root without scanning all children. The returned object is owned by the streamer and may be freed by the next streaming update. Never cache it without an instance-validity check. Does not trigger a load.

method.name: set_streaming_source
method.description: Registers or updates one named extra streaming source at the given world-space position. Radius can be 0 or 1 cell (default 0); priority can be 0 (background), 1 (normal/default), 2 (important), or 3 (urgent). Higher-priority sources are scheduled first within the common streaming budgets, after the observer and pinned hubs and before velocity prediction. Equal-priority names use alphabetical order, independent of dictionary iteration order. Updating a registered source with an omitted priority resets it to the normal default 1; use [method set_streaming_source_priority] to change priority without moving a source. The scheduler cannot preempt an already-running thread. Returns [code]false[/code] for invalid data or when creating a ninth source; updating an existing one is allowed. It shares existing asynchronous request and instantiation budgets. This runtime state is not serialized.

method.name: remove_streaming_source
method.description: Removes a named extra source. Its formerly requested cells become eligible for unloading, unless they are still required by the observer, a pinned hub or another source.

method.name: clear_streaming_sources
method.description: Clears all extra sources without affecting the primary observer or pinned hubs.

method.name: has_streaming_source
method.description: Returns whether the named extra streaming source is registered.

method.name: get_streaming_source_count
method.description: Returns the number of extra sources, excluding the observer and pinned hubs. Maximum is 8.

method.name: get_streaming_source_cell
method.description: Converts the named source's global position to a local grid coordinate, returning (0, 0) when the source is absent. Check [method has_streaming_source] first.

method.name: set_detail_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Sets the extra number of cell rings (0 to 8) an already-full-detail cell can remain in level 0 before being demoted. New cells and distant-to-near promotions still use [member detail_radius]. Zero restores the original single threshold.

method.name: get_detail_hysteresis_cells
method.description: Returns the number of extra rings used exclusively when demoting a previously-near cell.

method.name: set_detail_radius
method.description: Sets the full-detail Chebyshev radius, in cells. -1 disables switching and requests detail level 0 for all loaded cells. A value of 0 keeps only the current cell fully detailed. Does not change [member load_radius] or create proxy meshes.

method.name: get_detail_radius
method.description: Returns the full-detail radius (-1 when distance LOD switching is disabled).

method.name: set_max_detail_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Limits the number of loaded cells allowed to rebuild their detail representation per frame, between 1 and 128.

method.name: get_max_detail_transitions_per_frame
method.description: Returns the maximum number of detail transitions per streaming update.

method.name: get_cell_detail_level
method.description: Returns 0 for full-detail or 1 for distant-detail cells whose roots implement [code]set_streaming_lod(level)[/code], or -1 if the cell has no active compatible root.

method.name: get_distant_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of loaded scene roots currently using distant detail level 1.

method.name: get_predictive_lookahead_seconds
method.description: Returns the configured projection horizon in seconds.

method.name: get_predictive_max_distance
method.description: Returns the maximum future-cell displacement in world units.

method.name: get_predictive_velocity
method.description: Returns the supplied world-space velocity in units per second.

method.name: get_predicted_cell
method.description: Returns the latest future cell, or (0, 0) if none. Call [method has_predicted_cell] first.

method.name: has_predicted_cell
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when prediction targets a different cell. Does not guarantee a registered or loaded scene.

method.name: set_predictive_velocity
method.description: Sets the world-space observer velocity. Non-finite values are rejected and speed is capped at 512 units/second. Game code should update this at physics cadence.

method.name: set_predictive_lookahead_seconds
method.description: Sets the prediction horizon in the range 0 to 5 seconds. Zero disables prefetch.

method.name: set_predictive_max_distance
method.description: Sets the cap on speculative displacement in the range 0 to 128 world units. Zero disables prefetch.

method.name: cell_to_local_position
method.description: Returns the local-space origin of [param cell]. The Y component is always zero.

method.name: clear_cell_scenes
method.description: Removes all registered cells and unloads instantiated cells.

method.name: get_cell_scene
method.description: Returns the registered scene path or an empty string if none exists.

method.name: get_cells_in_radius
method.description: Returns all coordinates in the square centered on [param center], including the boundary. The radius must be between 0 and 32 inclusive.

method.name: get_configured_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered scene paths, whether loaded or unloaded.

method.name: get_pinned_cell_count
method.description: Returns how many registered cells are explicitly pinned to remain loaded, up to 128.

method.name: get_pinned_cells
method.description: Returns an unordered snapshot of pinned [Vector2i] coordinates. Modifying the returned array does not modify the partition.

method.name: get_loaded_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of tracked instantiated cells.

method.name: get_pending_cell_count
method.description: Returns how many registered cells are waiting for their scene resource to finish loading or to be instantiated. This is a runtime streaming diagnostic, not the total number of configured cells.

method.name: get_inflight_request_count
method.description: Returns the number of distinct asynchronous resource paths whose background loads have not completed. Several cells using the same scene path share one request.

method.name: get_failed_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of cells that failed to load or instantiate. Failed cells are not retried until their configuration changes.

method.name: has_observer_cell
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after the configured [member observer_path] has resolved to a [Node3D] and a streaming update has computed its cell.

method.name: get_observer_cell
method.description: Returns the last observed cell in this node's local grid coordinates. Only meaningful when [method has_observer_cell] is [code]true[/code]. This result updates when the observer enters a new cell or its grid configuration changes.

method.name: get_loaded_cells
method.description: Returns the cell coordinates of currently instantiated scenes.

method.name: is_cell_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the cell has a living instantiated scene.

method.name: is_cell_pinned
method.description: Returns whether [param cell] is explicitly retained independent of the observer distance.

method.name: pin_cell
method.description: Keeps the registered scene at [param cell] active even when outside [member unload_radius]. Returns [code]true[/code] only for a newly added pin. Unregistered coordinates and requests past the 128-cell limit are rejected. Pinned cells still obey normal loading/instantiation budgets. Pins are not serialized as a property: restore them in gameplay code after loading a world.

method.name: local_position_to_cell
method.description: Converts a local-space position to its grid coordinate using floor division. Negative positions belong to negative cells.

method.name: remove_cell_scene
method.description: Unregisters [param cell] and unloads its existing instance.

method.name: set_cell_scene
method.description: Registers a resource path for a cell. An empty path removes the mapping. Replacing a path unloads the previous cell.

method.name: unpin_cell
method.description: Releases a pin. The cell becomes eligible for normal radius-based unloading on the next streaming update; a cell inside the observer radius stays loaded.

method.name: update_streaming
method.description: Polls background requests and updates cells around the observer. The node calls this method every frame while streaming is enabled.

method.name: acquire_cell_lease
method.description: Acquires an independent residency claim for a cell and returns its positive token, or 0 when the maximum 256 simultaneous tokens are in use. Multiple independent owners can acquire the same cell. Leases use normal asynchronous streaming budgets and cannot bypass disabled [member layer_states] or [member streaming_enabled]. Tokens belong to this WorldPartition3D instance and must be released explicitly.

method.name: acquire_cell_route
method.description: Atomically acquires one independent lease per cell in a four-connected route from [param from_cell] to [param to_cell], including both endpoints. Returns an [Array] of positive lease tokens in traversal order, or an empty Array when the route is too long, intersects an inactive Data Layer, or exceeds remaining token capacity. No partial leases are retained on failure. The maximum route length is 64 cells and every lease uses the normal streaming budgets. Route cells are a streaming corridor, not an obstacle-aware navigation path.

method.name: capture_cell_object_states
method.description: Captures only the currently loaded cell's opted-in child objects and returns its cached state dictionary. Objects must be in the streaming_stateful group and implement capture_streaming_object_state(). If the cell is unloaded, returns the cached copy unchanged. Emits cell_object_state_changed only when a captured value actually changes.

method.name: clear_cell_layer
method.description: Removes the layer assignment of [param cell], making it eligible for normal distance/pin-based streaming irrespective of inactive layer states. Does not delete the registered scene or its saved gameplay state.

method.name: clear_cell_leases
method.description: Releases all independent runtime lease tokens without touching [method get_pinned_cells], scene registrations or saved gameplay progress. Any formerly retained scenes become eligible for normal budgeted unloading.

method.name: clear_cell_object_states
method.description: Clears cached interactive-object records for every cell, without changing already loaded objects. Subsequent captures or unloads populate the cache again if persist_streaming_objects is enabled.

method.name: clear_cell_physics_states
method.description: Clears all stored rigid-body motion snapshots for all cells. This does not alter loaded bodies. The cache can be populated again by unloading or snapshotting active cells while [member persist_rigid_bodies] is enabled.

method.name: clear_cell_states
method.description: Removes all cached runtime state dictionaries. Does not change scene registrations, pins or already loaded scene objects. If those objects are unloaded later, their optional capture callback may repopulate state.

method.name: clear_pinned_cells
method.description: Releases all runtime cell pins. Cells outside every observer's unload radius become eligible for normal budgeted unloading at the next update.

method.name: clear_route_connection_link
method.description: Removes an explicit link requirement registered by set_route_connection_link for the exact directed pair, without altering the NavigationLink3D node, its saved enabled state or any outstanding cell leases.

method.name: erase_cell_state
method.description: Discards the cached gameplay state for a single cell without unloading its scene.

method.name: get_cell_layer
method.description: Returns the assigned layer name for this cell, or an empty string when no layer is assigned.

method.name: get_cell_layers
method.description: Returns a copy of [member cell_layers]. Modifying the result does not change the layer configuration.

method.name: get_cell_lease_count
method.description: Returns the number of independent runtime lease tokens currently retaining the specified cell, excluding manual pins and observer sources.

method.name: get_cell_lease_count_total
method.description: Returns the total number of independent active lease tokens in this WorldPartition3D, limited to 256.

method.name: get_cell_object_state_count
method.description: Returns the number of cells currently holding at least one saved interactive-object record.

method.name: get_cell_object_states
method.description: Returns a deep copy of the saved dictionary for a cell. Keys are scene-relative node paths as Strings. Each value is a small, value-only Dictionary from the object's capture_streaming_object_state() method. Returns an empty Dictionary if no object records exist.

method.name: get_cell_physics_state
method.description: Returns a defensive deep copy of the cached rigid-body state for a cell. Its keys are scene-relative NodePaths represented by Strings, and values contain a local [Transform3D], linear/angular [Vector3] velocities and sleeping/freeze booleans. Returns an empty dictionary if no data is cached.

method.name: get_cell_physics_state_count
method.description: Returns the number of cells containing at least one cached opted-in rigid-body record, not the total number of saved bodies.

method.name: get_cell_route
method.description: Returns a deterministic array of adjacent [Vector2i] cells along a four-connected grid corridor, including both endpoints. The coordinate sequence is bounded to at most 64 cells; longer routes return an empty array. Each step is orthogonally adjacent, so a navigation agent never skips a whole intermediate cell during prefetch. This method does not acquire leases, validate scene registrations, bake navigation meshes or solve obstacle avoidance.

method.name: get_cell_simulation_stats
method.description: Returns an on-demand count of loaded physics and navigation components under the specified cell root, including descendants: [code]collision_objects[/code] (CollisionObject3D), [code]collision_shapes[/code] (CollisionShape3D) and [code]navigation_regions[/code] (NavigationRegion3D). Unloaded cells return zeros. This traverses the instantiated cell hierarchy; do not call it for all cells every frame in production.

method.name: get_cell_state
method.description: Returns a deep copy of the stored gameplay state for a cell, or an empty dictionary if none is stored. This does not invoke capture on active scenes; use [method snapshot_cell_states] to gather their latest state.

method.name: get_cell_state_count
method.description: Returns the number of cells with nonempty cached gameplay state.

method.name: get_disabled_navigation_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of distinct cells currently disabled for navigation, regardless of whether they have a loaded scene or existing route lease. Only explicit false entries are stored.

method.name: get_disabled_navigation_link_count
method.description: Returns the total number of disabled navigation link paths in all cells, regardless of whether their scenes are currently loaded.

method.name: get_layer_states
method.description: Returns a copy of [member layer_states]. Missing layer names are enabled by default.

method.name: get_leased_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of distinct cell coordinates currently covered by at least one runtime lease, even when their scenes are not loaded or their layers are disabled.

method.name: get_navigation_cell_states
method.description: Returns a defensive copy of the navigation gate state map (Vector2i to false). Cells missing from the map are enabled by default. Store this dictionary in a game checkpoint if gates must survive a save/load.

method.name: get_navigation_link_states
method.description: Returns a defensive deep copy of the saved navigation link state map. Only disabled links are stored, and link paths are relative to the authored cell scene root. Save this alongside interactive-object states in checkpoints.

method.name: get_route_connection_link
method.description: Returns the registered scene-relative link path belonging to from_cell for the exact directed edge from_cell to to_cell, or an empty String if the edge has no explicit link requirement. Reverse-direction route acquisition automatically checks this registered edge as well.

method.name: has_cell_state
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a nonempty gameplay state is cached for the cell.

method.name: is_cell_layer_enabled
method.description: Returns whether a cell's assigned layer permits it to load. Unassigned cells are enabled. This does not imply that a scene is currently loaded.

method.name: is_cell_navigation_enabled
method.description: Returns whether a cell's navigation regions are enabled. Missing entries default to true. A disabled cell remains in the scene and retains its physics, graphics and existing leases, but new acquire_cell_route requests passing through it are rejected.

method.name: is_cell_navigation_link_enabled
method.description: Returns the persisted logical availability of an authored NavigationLink3D by cell-relative path. Paths missing from the map are enabled by default. This can be queried even when the cell scene has not loaded.

method.name: is_layer_enabled
method.description: Returns the effective runtime state of the named layer. An unregistered layer or empty name defaults to enabled.

method.name: is_persisting_rigid_bodies
method.description: Returns whether [member persist_rigid_bodies] is enabled.

method.name: is_persisting_streaming_objects
method.description: Returns whether persist_streaming_objects is enabled for this streamer.

method.name: load_cell_object_states
method.description: Replaces cached interactive-object states from a Vector2i-to-Dictionary map, filtering unsafe paths, object references, unsupported types, nonfinite numbers and excess entries. Maximum 128 child object records per cell and 32 fields per record; accepted values include bool, int, finite float, short String, Vector2/Vector3 and integer vector variants. When enabled, existing loaded objects receive restore_streaming_object_state(state) immediately; missing records receive an empty Dictionary to reset to authored defaults.

method.name: load_cell_physics_states
method.description: Replaces cached rigid-body state with validated [Vector2i] to [Dictionary] mappings. Each body record must use a safe relative node path, finite transform and velocities, and bool sleeping/freeze flags; invalid values and unsafe paths are ignored. Up to 128 records are accepted per cell. Existing loaded opted-in bodies are updated immediately when a matching record is present. Missing records leave existing loaded body state unchanged. Imported states can restore later when the cell is streamed again.

method.name: load_cell_states
method.description: Replaces the entire state cache with valid [Vector2i] to [Dictionary] mappings, ignoring other entries. Passes deep copies into active scene roots that implement [code]restore_streaming_state(state)[/code]. Empty dictionaries are ignored. Caller is responsible for validating save files before invoking this method.

method.name: release_cell_lease
method.description: Releases exactly one independent owner token. Returns true once, or false for an unknown or previously released token. A cell still needed by another lease, manual pin or observer remains active. Without owners, it becomes eligible for normal unload even without any observer.

method.name: release_cell_route
method.description: Releases each valid integer lease token in [param tokens], returning the number actually released. Unknown tokens, duplicated tokens and unsupported array entries do not release another owner's lease. May be used to cancel an AI route or on node teardown; call only with tokens acquired from the intended WorldPartition3D instance.

method.name: set_cell_layer
method.description: Assigns [param cell] to a single named layer. Passing an empty layer removes its assignment. A change to an inactive layer unloads its scene over the normal frame budget.

method.name: set_cell_layers
method.description: Replaces the dictionary of [Vector2i] to nonempty [String] layer assignments. Invalid dictionary entries are omitted. Existing scene registrations, pinning and cached gameplay state are preserved.

method.name: set_cell_navigation_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables every NavigationRegion3D descendant of the loaded scene for a given cell, without unloading it. Removes the map entry when enabled is true. Emits cell_navigation_state_changed only for effective transitions. A disabled gate blocks new acquire_cell_route reservations; existing lease owners keep their tokens. The NavigationServer3D synchronizes topology changes on the following physics frame.

method.name: set_cell_navigation_link_enabled
method.description: Switches one NavigationLink3D child under the loaded scene at cell without disabling its NavigationRegion3D nodes. The link_path is a safe relative NodePath from that cell root, at most 256 characters long. Disabled paths are stored for unloaded cells, reinstated after scene activation, and included in get_navigation_link_states(). Emits cell_navigation_link_state_changed only for effective transitions.

method.name: set_cell_state
method.description: Stores a deep copy of [param state] for a cell. An empty dictionary erases a previous cached state. For an active scene root with a [code]restore_streaming_state(state)[/code] method, a copy is applied immediately.

method.name: set_layer_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables a named runtime layer. Disabled layers prevent new loads (including pinned cells), cancel their pending scene instantiations, and unload loaded cells within [member max_unloads_per_frame]. Other layers remain unaffected. Empty names are rejected.

method.name: set_layer_states
method.description: Replaces the dictionary of named runtime states. Only nonempty [String] keys with [bool] values are accepted. Missing layer names are active by default. Useful for restoring event-state data from a save game.

method.name: set_navigation_cell_states
method.description: Replaces the current cell navigation gate map with validated Vector2i-to-bool entries (only false entries are stored). Immediately applies changes to loaded NavigationRegion3D descendants, and emits cell_navigation_state_changed per effective transition, including reopening gates removed by a bulk checkpoint import. Cells missing from the dictionary are enabled by default.

method.name: set_navigation_link_states
method.description: Replaces the saved per-link gate state, validated as Vector2i cell to Dictionary of safe relative String paths to false values. Accepts at most 4096 cells and 128 disabled links per cell. Applies changes to loaded NavigationLink3D nodes and emits link-state signals only for effective changes, including reopening links removed from a save. Link topology updates are synchronized by NavigationServer3D on later physics frames.

method.name: set_persist_rigid_bodies
method.description: Enables/disables automatic physics capture on cell unloading and restoration on cell instantiation. Only [RigidBody3D] descendants with [code]set_meta("streaming_persistent", true)[/code] are included. Existing physics cache is not cleared when disabled. No physics state is written to disk unless the game calls [method snapshot_cell_physics_states] and saves it.

method.name: set_persist_streaming_objects
method.description: Enables or disables automated per-child object capture and restore. Nodes must be descendants of a loaded cell root, belong to group streaming_stateful, and implement capture_streaming_object_state() and restore_streaming_object_state(Dictionary). Default is false. Scene root gameplay state and RigidBody3D physics persistence remain independent.

method.name: retry_failed_cells
method.description: Clears all failure markers so failed cells that are still in range are requested again on the next streaming update. Registrations and already loaded scenes are unchanged. Call it from a deliberate recovery action, not every frame; a persistent failure is requested again each time.

method.name: set_pinned_cells
method.description: Replaces the pinned cell coordinates, preserving the first occurrence of each [Vector2i]. Unsupported array entries and unregistered cells are skipped. Arrays with more than 128 entries are rejected without changing existing pins. The normalized result is returned by [method get_pinned_cells].

method.name: set_route_connection_link
method.description: Registers one explicitly authored NavigationLink3D (under from_cell) as the required connection to an orthogonally adjacent to_cell. During acquire_cell_route(), both travel directions check the saved link availability before allocating any token leases. Does not create the scene node or pathfinding geometry; authors must place the link inside the source cell. Static route registrations are runtime configuration and are not included in navigation_link_states saves.

method.name: snapshot_cell_object_states
method.description: Captures the states of opted-in objects in all currently loaded cells (if enabled) and returns a deep copy of the object-state cache, including previously unloaded cells. Call before saving a checkpoint so still-resident objects are included. The engine does not write a file automatically.

method.name: snapshot_cell_physics_states
method.description: Captures up to 128 opted-in [RigidBody3D] descendants from each active cell, if [member persist_rigid_bodies] is enabled, and returns a deep-copy dictionary mapping [Vector2i] cell coordinates to per-body state dictionaries. Suitable for a save-game bridge with [code]FileAccess.store_var[/code]. Captures transform, linear/angular velocities, sleep and freeze state before normal cell deactivation.

method.name: snapshot_cell_states
method.description: Captures the latest state of active cell roots implementing [code]capture_streaming_state()[/code], then returns a deep-copy [Dictionary] of [Vector2i] keys to state dictionaries. Returns only nonempty states. Compatible with [code]FileAccess.store_var(snapshot)[/code] and [code]FileAccess.get_var(false)[/code] when values are serializable Variants without objects. Does not save a file automatically.

members.member: Maximum size of the exact-key least-recently-used cache for [method find_cell_path] results, including empty paths. Valid range is 0 to 128 (0 disables). The engine invalidates all routes on changes to registered scene topology, but invalidates only [code]loaded_only[/code] entries when scene roots load or unload. NavMesh obstacle edits do not change registered cell-grid topology and therefore do not evict these topological routes.

Maximum number of opt-in [code]rebuild_streaming_navigation_mesh()[/code] callbacks attempted per engine physics frame, from 1 to 16. Duplicate invalidations of one cell are coalesced, nearest observer cells are serviced first, and a successful callback resets the cell's navigation readiness fence.

Independent active navigation-region radius: -1 for all loaded cells (default), otherwise 0 through 32 cell rings. Pinned and important/urgent source cells remain navigation active. Cell scenes implement [code]set_streaming_navigation_active(active)[/code] to own their NavigationRegion3D lifetime.
0 to 8 extra cell rings of navigation demotion hysteresis for previously active regions.

Maximum number of already-loaded cell navigation-region tier transitions per streaming frame, 1 to 64. This is separate from [member max_navigation_updates_per_physics_frame], which throttles expensive NPC path recalculations.

Maximum number of native navigation work permits issued per physics frame across up to 128 registered Node3D agents, 1 to 64. Uses a deterministic priority-first and least-recently-selected schedule, constrained to live agents in loaded, simulation-active, physics-active cells. This limits caller-submitted expensive steering/path refreshes, not the agent's actual movement/physics updates.

Independent collision policy radius in cell rings, -1 (all loaded active, default) or 0 to 32. Pinned hubs and priorities 2 or 3 streaming sources force active collision and full visual LOD. Scene roots implement [code]set_streaming_physics_active(active)[/code] to actually filter colliders. Background sources do not force physics.
0 to 8 extra rings tolerated before an already-active collision scene is deactivated. New inactive cells activate within [member physics_radius], pinned hubs, or important sources.
1 to 64 maximum physics enable/disable transitions across already-loaded cells per update. Initial state is assigned before scene [code]_ready()[/code].

Minimum number of completed physics ticks after loading a cell before it may pass the optional activation readiness check. Valid range 0 to 8. Scenes can implement [code]is_streaming_activation_ready()[/code] to gate their own colliders, navmesh or gameplay setup. The counter resets when a cell is unloaded and later instantiated again. This does not guarantee that all engine physics or rendering servers have synchronized.

Independent simulation-active neighborhood, -1 (disabled, all loaded cells active) or 0 to 32 cell rings. Unlike [member detail_radius], this is a logical activation flag for AI/script systems and never unloads graphics. Scene roots may opt into [code]set_streaming_simulation_active(active)[/code] and game controllers can call [method is_cell_simulation_active]. Pinned cells are always active.
Additional 0 to 8 cell rings tolerated before disabling an already-active cell. Inactive cells activate only within [member simulation_radius].
Maximum number of existing loaded cell activation changes per frame (1 to 64). Initial activation on scene instantiation is not budgeted.

Extra cell rings tolerated before an already-near loaded scene is downgraded to distant detail. A far scene upgrades only inside [member detail_radius], reducing back-and-forth regeneration near cell boundaries. The default is 0 for backward compatibility; maximum 8. New cells always use [member detail_radius] without hysteresis.
Full-detail neighborhood radius, from -1 (disabled) through 32. Within that radius (and for pinned cells), scene roots receive detail level 0. Outside, loaded compatible scene roots receive level 1.
Maximum number of already-loaded cell roots switched between detail levels in a streaming update. Valid range is 1 to 128.
Dictionary mapping [Vector2i] coordinates to [String] scene resource paths. Invalid keys and values are discarded.
Width and depth of a single square cell in local 3D units.
Radius in cells to load around the observer, between 0 and 32.
Maximum simultaneous background resource-load requests made by this node.
Maximum number of loaded cell scenes instantiated per frame.
Maximum number of new resource-load requests per frame.
Path relative to this node pointing to a [Node3D] observer, such as a player or camera.
World-space velocity for speculative streaming; supply it from the active moving character in gameplay code.
Forecast horizon from 0 to 5 seconds. The default of zero disables prefetch.
Maximum future-cell displacement (0 to 128 world units). One additional cell at most is speculatively loaded.
Enables or disables streaming. Disabling unloads tracked instances and preserves cell registrations.
Cells outside this radius are unloaded. Must be at least [member load_radius].

A dictionary assigning each [Vector2i] cell coordinate to one named [String] runtime layer. Each cell may be assigned to at most one layer. Unassigned cells are always eligible for distance- or pin-based loading.

A dictionary from nonempty layer [String] names to [bool] enabled states. Missing layers are enabled. Disabling a layer unloads its cells, even if they are pinned or near a streaming observer, subject to the normal unload budget.

Maximum number of out-of-range cell scenes to queue for deletion in one streaming update, between 1 and 128. Remaining cells are considered on subsequent frames. Explicit clear/remove operations and disabling streaming unload immediately without this limit.

Per-cell dynamic navigation gates, mapping [Vector2i] to [code]false[/code]. All unlisted cells default to enabled. Disabled cells have their loaded NavigationRegion3D descendants disabled, do not admit new route leases through [method acquire_cell_route], but preserve existing leases and other scene components. Regions resynchronize on the next physics frame.

Per-cell NavigationLink3D enable overrides indexed by a Vector2i coordinate and then a scene-relative String NodePath. Only explicitly disabled paths are stored. Unlike navigation_cell_states, closing a link leaves the parent NavigationRegion3D nodes enabled. Author its geometry and register required intercell edges with set_route_connection_link().

If enabled, the streamer automatically saves and restores local transforms, linear/angular velocities, sleeping and freeze state for [RigidBody3D] descendants marked with [code]streaming_persistent = true[/code] metadata. Bodies without the explicit flag are not captured. The cache survives unloads but is not written to disk automatically. [method snapshot_cell_physics_states] exports it for a game's checkpoint system.

When enabled, descendants in group streaming_stateful can save independent interactive state through capture_streaming_object_state() and restore_streaming_object_state(Dictionary). Value-only records are cached by cell and scene-relative NodePath, while snapshot_cell_object_states() exports them to a save game. Objects not in the group are ignored.

signal.name: cell_navigation_mesh_rebuilt
signal.description: Emitted after a scene-owned navigation mesh rebuild callback successfully returns Boolean true. The NavigationServer3D mesh update still needs physics-frame synchronization before [method is_cell_navigation_ready] becomes true.

signal.name: cell_navigation_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a loaded cell changes its native navigation-region activation tier. Initial scene-root state is delivered through [code]set_streaming_navigation_active(active)[/code] before its [code]_ready()[/code] without this transition signal.

signal.name: cell_physics_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a previously loaded cell changes native collision activation state. Newly loaded scenes instead receive [code]set_streaming_physics_active(active)[/code] before [code]_ready()[/code].

signal.name: cell_simulation_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a loaded cell switches its simulation activation state. New cell initialization uses [signal cell_loaded] instead; scripts implementing [code]set_streaming_simulation_active(active)[/code] receive that call before [code]_ready()[/code] for the initial state.

signal.name: cell_detail_changed
signal.description: Emitted when an already-instantiated cell implements [code]set_streaming_lod(level)[/code] and the engine changes its detail level from 0 (near) to 1 (distant) or back.

signal.name: cell_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after a [PackedScene] is instantiated as a child of this node.

signal.name: observer_cell_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the observer enters a different grid cell (including the first resolved cell after setting [member observer_path] or changing [member cell_size]). Use this to trigger cell-based game logic without checking the observer's position every frame.

signal.name: cell_unloaded
signal.description: Emitted when a previously instantiated cell is queued for deletion.

signal.name: cell_activated
signal.description: Emitted after a cell scene has entered the tree, finished [code]_ready()[/code], restored cached gameplay state and received its optional [code]streaming_activated(cell)[/code] callback. The cell is in [code]active_cells[/code], but NavigationServer3D requires a later physics frame to synchronize regions for path queries.

signal.name: cell_deactivating
signal.description: Emitted after the root's optional [code]streaming_deactivating(cell)[/code] callback, before [code]capture_streaming_state()[/code], scene removal and [code]queue_free()[/code]. Use this opportunity to release external references, disable collision participation and remove navigation registrations before deferred deletion. [signal cell_unloaded] follows the unload bookkeeping.

signal.name: cell_navigation_link_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when one authored NavigationLink3D logical state changes, including changes made by bulk checkpoint restoration. AI owners can release route leases and replan through NavigationServer3D after its next physics synchronization. Repeated idempotent changes do not re-emit this signal.

signal.name: cell_navigation_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a cell changes effective navigability through [method set_cell_navigation_enabled] or [method set_navigation_cell_states]. NPCs can release stale corridor leases and requery navigation after the NavigationServer3D physics synchronization. Identical updates do not emit a signal.

signal.name: cell_object_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted after a cell captures a genuinely changed set of interactive-object records, either on unload, explicit capture_cell_object_states() or snapshot_cell_object_states(). The dictionary is a defensive copy. Bulk load_cell_object_states() does not emit per-cell notifications.

signal.name: cell_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method set_cell_state] changes a cached per-cell state or when a loaded scene returns new data from [code]capture_streaming_state()[/code] on unloading or snapshot. The signal carries an independent [Dictionary] copy, including an empty dictionary when a state is erased. Reassigning identical state data does not emit. [method load_cell_states] is a bulk import and does not emit this signal for each cell.

signal.name: layer_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method set_layer_enabled] or [method set_layer_states] changes a layer's effective enabled state. Unspecified layers default to enabled, so explicitly setting such a layer to [code]true[/code] does not emit. Bulk state replacement reports affected layers individually, including layers which become enabled again by removal of an explicit disabled entry.
